title: The invoice pile that chases itself

message.text: Hi Mehta ji, a gentle reminder: INV-1042 was due on 12 Sep.

scenes.vo: Every one of these is an *unpaid invoice,* and someone chases each one *by hand.*
Here's the *fix.* Four steps, running on their own.
It reads your *sheet,* spots what's *overdue,* and sends a polite *WhatsApp reminder.*
When the money lands, it marks the invoice *paid.* Nobody chases it again.
Want this running for your business? DM me AUDIT.
scenes.sub: I'll show you what to automate first.

caption:
Unpaid invoices don't need a person chasing them every morning.

A small automation can read your receivables sheet, send a polite WhatsApp reminder when something is overdue, and mark it paid when the money lands.

Example data.
